meta.name: security-audit
meta.description: Deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency vulnerabilities, and secrets scanning. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码中的安全漏洞与配置风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在发布前发现并修复安全漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Scan code for security vulnerabilities and configuration risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and fix security vulnerabilities before release.

howto.what: Claude 会调用 Centinela 代理审计代码:逐项检查 OWASP Top 10、扫描硬编码密钥、依赖漏洞,有 Solidity 时查智能合约;最后给出通过/需修改的结论并写报告。
howto.when: 输入 /security-audit(可附带路径)时触发;不带路径时默认审计 src/ 整个目录。

say.text: 对 src/payments/ 做一次安全审计
say.note: 以此目录为范围生成审计报告。

say.text: 审计整个代码库,按 OWASP 列风险
say.note: 不指定范围会覆盖整个 src/。

say.text: 查一下依赖有没有已知 CVE 漏洞
say.note: 会做依赖漏洞扫描并列入报告。

howto.what_en: Claude delegates to the Centinela agent to audit code: checks OWASP Top 10, hardcoded secrets, dependency vulnerabilities, and smart contracts if Solidity is present; then gives an APPROVED or CHANGES REQUIRED verdict and writes a report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user enters /security-audit (optionally with paths); with no explicit path, the entire src/ directory is audited.

say_en.text: Run a security audit on src/payments/
say_en.note: Audits only that folder and returns a report.

say_en.text: Audit the whole codebase and list OWASP risks
say_en.note: No scope means the full src/ is covered.

say_en.text: Check my dependencies for known CVEs
